sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated an allegation that a senior doctor tried to pressure a registrar to change a patient's recorded date of death.
sentences.support: It was alleged that an executive officer attempted to coerce a Medical Service Registrar into changing the date of death

sentences.text: The Commission did not substantiate the allegation and decided to take no further action.
sentences.support: The investigation did not substantiate the allegation. The Commission will therefore take no further action.

sentences.text: The Commission identified risks in reliance on paper medical records after clinical notes could not be located.
sentences.support: It did, however, highlight the serious misconduct risks in relying on paper records.

findings.quote: The Commission has completed its investigation and has not identified serious misconduct in relation to the allegation.

notes: The Commission expressly makes no finding about the cause or circumstances of the patient's death. No patient or medical practitioner is named in the summary.
